title: Prepare ad-hoc release for 2025-12-01 wave of providers
body:

Summary of prepared documentation:

Success: 11

amazon celery cncf.kubernetes common.sql docker edge3 google microsoft.azure slack ssh standard

Please review the updated files, classify the changelog entries and commit the changes.
